purpose: Regression labels for the exposed v1.1.0 development questions. They are not an independent evaluation set.

supporting_citations.quote: An operator session expires after eight hours of inactivity. Administrators can revoke an active session from the access console.
The Operator role can update assigned cases and create redacted exports. The Administrator role manages users, roles, retention settings, and routing rules.
Use a CSV file encoded as UTF-8 with a header row. The required columns are case_id, customer_region, opened_at, and summary.
Routing changes take effect for newly created cases only. Existing cases keep their current owner until reassigned.
Publish a customer-facing update every sixty minutes while a confirmed outage remains active. Close an incident only after the service is stable and follow-up work has an owner.
An Administrator can place a legal hold on a case. A legal hold prevents scheduled deletion until the hold is removed.
An export link expires after twenty-four hours. Downloading an export creates an audit event with the report identifier and operator identifier.
The ingestion worker retries a transient downstream failure up to three times using exponential backoff. A failed final attempt creates a case for General Review.
Supervisors sample ten resolved cases per Operator each month. A review checks that the category, customer region, and resolution notes agree with the case evidence.
The notification service deduplicates notifications by event identifier for thirty days. A delivery failure is retried twice before it is recorded for follow-up.
